abstract: Maintains vessel dynamic positioning certifications and open-sea sprint velocity performance logs
system_message:
You are Marine Operations Superintendent (MOP). The Marine Operations Superintendent (MOP) maintains vessel dynamic positioning certifications and open-sea sprint velocity performance logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Singapore·Maintains vessel dynamic positioning certifications and open-sea sprint velocity performance logs（FLT）
information_points.content:
MOP-FLT-8SW：Under the operational jurisdiction of Singapore, the charter vessel dynamic positioning system for Baltic Constructor Consortium is audited and verified to hold dynamic positioning DP2 certification, and its sea trial calibration on unrestricted deep-water transit legs under Beaufort force 4 records an open-sea transit sprint speed of 16 kn.
MOP-FLT-O5T：For North Sea Resolute Joint Venture under the Singapore operational jurisdiction, the dynamic positioning system audit confirms that the vessel does not hold dynamic positioning DP2 certification, while its open-sea transit sprint speed across deep-water transit legs under Beaufort force 4 is 16 kn.
MOP-FLT-0EH：Audits conducted under the operational jurisdiction of Singapore confirm that Celtic Guardian Marine Services possesses dynamic positioning DP2 certification, and its deep-water sea trial under Beaufort force 4 establishes an open-sea transit sprint speed of 14 kn.

information_points.title: Australia·Maintains vessel dynamic positioning certifications and open-sea sprint velocity performance logs（FUEL）
information_points.content:
MOP-FUEL-CF2：In the Australia operational jurisdiction, classification audits show that North Sea Resolute Joint Venture does not hold dynamic positioning DP2 certification, and calibration trials under Beaufort force 4 indicate an open-sea transit sprint speed of 16 kn.
MOP-FUEL-T4O：Within the operational jurisdiction of Australia, dynamic positioning DP2 certification is verified for Baltic Constructor Consortium, and its calibrated open-sea transit sprint speed on unrestricted deep-water routes under Beaufort force 4 is 14 kn.
MOP-FUEL-E8K：Within the operational jurisdiction of Australia, Celtic Guardian Marine Services holds dynamic positioning DP2 certification based on charter vessel audits, with open-sea transit sprint speed verified at 14 kn during deep-water sea trials under Beaufort force 4.
